public_balance_sheet_register.expected_loss: Negative net income/deferred asset until future earnings offset losses
public_balance_sheet_register.stress_scenario: High-rate environment, market dysfunction, or emergency lending loss while public services need fiscal space
public_balance_sheet_register.funding_source: future Fed earnings retained before remittances, interest-rate policy, facility fees and collateral haircuts
public_balance_sheet_register.loss_sharing: Facility participants may post collateral/pay fees; asset holders gain from stabilization without explicit clawback

public_balance_sheet_register.ordinary_claimant_protection: Keep liquidity support from becoming unscored asset-holder rescue; publish beneficiary and remittance effects
public_balance_sheet_register.sunset_or_review: semiannual balance sheet developments and annual audited statements
